request.description: One original closed atlas book for a Minecraft inventory item. Compact diagonal book silhouette with dark moss green leather cover, tiny aged copper clasp, visible ivory page edge and narrow spine. One simple copper map mark on the cover. Same restrained pixel density and proportions as a vanilla Minecraft book. Genuine native 16x16 pixel clusters. The entire object fits inside the canvas with a transparent margin. No text, no glow, no ornamental jewels, no scene.
